restaurantName: AURA by Alexander Herrmann & Tobias Bätz
bio: In their chic, modern and elegant fine dining restaurant, seasoned chef duo Alexander Herrmann and Tobias Bätz deliver regionally inspired cuisine with a distinctive touch. For their set menu (vegetarian version available), they use the finest ingredients Franconia has to offer to create imaginative dishes, some of which are very intricate. For example, Zander mit Haxe (pike-perch with knuckle of pork) features a perfectly cooked, translucent pike-perch fillet, which is paired with Bamberg Savoy cabbage and kale, as well as a pork knuckle broth with a pleasing heat provided by pimientos and sriracha.
